prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady walk along a narrow, dirt path bordered by dense foliage and a rustic wooden fence on the right side. The camera moves forward, capturing the uneven terrain and scattered rocks underfoot, while the surrounding trees cast dappled shadows across the path. As the viewer progresses, the path gently curves to the left, revealing more of the overgrown vegetation and the cloudy sky above. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive view of the natural surroundings. The muted colors of the environment, dominated by earthy browns and greens, enhance the serene atmosphere. The path continues uphill, leading towards a cluster of old stone buildings partially covered in ivy. The camera pans slightly to the right, showcasing the weathered structures and their integration into the landscape. The final segment of the journey offers a breathtaking view of the ocean stretching out to the horizon, framed by the cloudy sky and the silhouettes of distant trees. The entire sequence maintains a consistent pace, with no sudden movements or changes, emphasizing the tranquil and isolated setting of Shengshan Island, Zhoushan, China.
